data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Very disappointing customer service.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a318c6a0294ec68649d237e)
Very disappointing customer service.

I ordered furniture pieces that were available and stocked on purpose because I had a deadline I was designing for. I ordered and then didn’t hear from anyone for two weeks. I followed up three times by email and twice by social - they don’t have any phone number to call! After numerous attempts I received a reprimanding email basically stating that they will get back to me when they can and to relax. The next day I received a call about my delivery. That’s how I was notified. It’s been close to four weeks and I still have not received my “ready to be shipped” furniture. Until I receive them I am very worried this is a scam company…

June 11, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 16, 2026

Hi Mónica,

Thank you for reaching out to us and sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with your order. To help expedite the freight shipping process, our Customer support team prioritized your order with our shipping carrier. Our support team also informed you that our carrier would reach out to you directly to schedule your delivery appointment as soon as the shipment reached the warehouse hub in your area. Thank you for your patience!

Lulu and Georgia
